'''TNI-36''', also known as "'''Tongue Loosener'''", was a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] used in interrogations that was also highly explosive.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
TNI-36 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during [[Star Fortress]] missions.
